Print the Fibonacci series using recursion.

Supplied answer
def fibonacci(n):
    if n <= 1:
        return n
    return fibonacci(n - 1) + fibonacci(n - 2)
for i in range(7):
    print(fibonacci(i), end=" ") # 0 1 1 2 3 5 8
Note: Simple but slow - it recalculates the same values many times (exponential time).
